annotations.title: Sectors and their stocks, ranked by returns in this market regime

description: Which sectors and stocks have done best and worst in markets like today's? Returns the ten sectors of the regimecard.com stocks page ranked by their stocks' median typical return over 1, 2 or 3 months from the current regime, each with its five highest and five lowest. With one sector named, every stock in it, ranked. It covers the stocks with Regime Card pages. Any other US stock can be checked one at a time with /v1/lookup. $0.05 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). One sector: $0.03 per call. Settled figures, updated after each US close: the ones the stock pages on regimecard.com print. Useful when an agent needs sector rotation context for the current market regime.

inputSchema.description: Query parameters, all optional. Any other value is a free 400.

sector.description: One sector: all its covered stocks, ranked, at the one-sector price. Without it, every sector.
